axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: All original product obligations are met in the final substance: investigation before revision, separate fee/status/task/confidence outcomes, A/B/C/D alternatives, heterogeneity, future history recovery, accessible research and revision decisions. No finished notice, translation, form or deployment is supplied; no invented center scores, demographics or equivalence are stated. Policies remain fixed. Actual external action absence is declared, not authenticated by a complete event log.

axes.name: Consequential source claims, precise scope and conditions
axes.assessment: Independently reopened all eleven governing source bindings and the RMIT project page. The final treats CDC/DfE/GOV.UK/HHS as bounded method/analogical sources, fixed WCAG criteria as proposed web checks, city pages as policy examples and RMIT as subjective document-specific evidence. Version, units, operation, audience/domain and applicable exceptions were checked. No material source error or unsupported selected winner remains. Minor comparator wording/self-containment limits are recorded.

axes.name: Useful discovery, competing/analogous approaches, history and opportunity breadth
axes.assessment: Useful alternatives are operational rather than vacuous: content/order against fixed words in changed presentation, unchanged notice, standardized support and owner clarification. Discovery identifies process-state distinctions and accessibility/language-support methods; post-reveal supplementation adds an empirical multilingual production comparison. Actual notice/translation/policy/channel/staff history is a future evidence request because no records exist in the packet. Independent investigation supports these leads; no case cause or universal template is inferred. Cost and independence consequences are qualitative (review/translation/device effort; recurring staff support and unassisted measurement), with budget honestly unresolved.

axes.name: Wrong criticism/corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: Every criticism is adjudicated below. The SCW diagnostics do not become forced corrections or universal prohibitions. The WCAG locator correction is supported. Every exact plan sentence/bullet is independently dispositioned in the clause appendix. Product scope is preserved; release-protocol language is limited by L03 and unavailable event telemetry.

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved across discovery, draft, critique and final
axes.assessment: The final preserves independent discovery’s fact/uncertainty boundary, five mechanisms, policy gate, meaningful comparisons and four outcomes; draft supplementation and transfer limits survive; critique clarifications survive without narrowing the authorized report. It remains a complete later-study proposal. Incidental sampling/session details are provisional, not guaranteed results. Corrected locator/wording defects and post-reveal evidence lineage are retained as H01–H03 rather than erased.

axes.name: Proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.assessment: Actually recorded scientific work is desk reading/source checking and writing, plus release/hash checks; no participant or actual notice/form/policy/translation/mobile/accessibility test is claimed. The proposed oracle is an approved fee/status fact map, not source agreement, readability or preferences. Separate observable outcomes, critical errors, uncertainty, assistance, first exposures, counterbalancing, language/access cells and revision gates are meaningful. Technical checks apply only to relevant web content and do not replace participant comprehension testing. Unpowered issue-finding and descriptive D changes are not population/causal proof.

limitations.finding: The final reports numbered RMIT methods without defining all four in the prose. Their definitions remain in the final source map and official report. This weakens stand-alone readability of the comparator, but does not choose a method or change the proposed A/B/C/D study.

primary_sources.title: CDC Clear Communication Index Score Sheet
primary_sources.inspected_locator: PDF pp. 1–3, 5; required audience/objective/message fields; conditional scoring parts
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Communication-design checklist. Four initial fields govern scoring; different translation audiences require separate materials/scoring; Parts B–D are conditional. Where literacy information is absent the sheet permits an average-to-low health-literacy assumption. No score or case demographic inference was made.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Health-communication checklist; no comprehension, accessibility or legal oracle.

primary_sources.title: GOV.UK Consider translations
primary_sources.version_or_release: Live page; no visible release date
primary_sources.inspected_locator: Consider translations, same-page direction, content-type exceptions; extracted text lines 45–53
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Translation policy/user need govern GOV.UK publication. The same-page direction applies within that publishing guidance; fatality notices/statistical data sets have content-type exclusions. It does not prove that all mixed-language web pages fail.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Compatible digital option; paper, SMS and other platforms remain open.

primary_sources.title: WCAG 2.2 fixed Recommendation
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Web content: text resize without assistive technology to 200%, excluding captions/images of text; text rather than images where technology can achieve presentation, except customizable/essential presentation; reflow at 320 CSS-pixel width for vertical scrolling or 256 CSS-pixel height for horizontal scrolling, except parts needing two-dimensional layout. Page default and passage language must be programmatically determinable, with named part-language exceptions.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Proposed narrow checks; selected criteria alone establish neither comprehension nor whole-site conformance/law.

primary_sources.title: Toronto recreation registration
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Programs costing more than $100 permit two installments: 50% at registration, remainder by first activity day. Full activities may have a waitlist; an opening brings email, or phone if no account email, with up to 36 hours to accept/decline. Waitlisting does not guarantee enrollment.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: City-specific process example only; no transfer of fees/status or comprehension effectiveness.

primary_sources.title: Austin account creation/registration FAQ
primary_sources.version_or_release: Live page; no visible update date
primary_sources.inspected_locator: FAQ: held spaces; full classes; partial payments
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: No spaces are allocated in advance to the online/walk-in/phone registration routes; all operate live subject to availability. Free waitlisting and an offer-payment deadline are explicit; expiry/decline removes the student from the roster. Deposits apply only to eligible classes. The held-space FAQ is not a blanket denial of post-registration reservations.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: City-specific allocation/payment example. The proposal does not import its policy.

primary_sources.title: RMIT multilingual public-service communication report
primary_sources.version_or_release: Title page June 2023; actual release date not independently established
primary_sources.inspected_locator: PDF pp. 9–15 methods/sample; Table 3 pp. 15–17 and discussion p. 18; pp. 19–23; Appendix IV pp. 52–55
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Four methods, seven languages and 21 readers. Table 3’s subjective preferences favor Methods 3/4 on A–C, with a D reversal. Sequential exposure, small cells and subjective measures limit inference. Appendix IV elicits main points but supplies no scored objective accuracy or task-completion oracle. Methods describe recruitment intent/sample, not its channel.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Source-bounded implementation lead, not a best translation method for course notices.
